instruction: Navigate to the customer service contact page on the United Airlines website.

metadata.explanation: Task variation: Navigate from United Airlines homepage to customer service contact page. Uses same URL pattern matching evaluator. Similar difficulty to original task (single navigation goal within same website).

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts active tab URL using get_active_tab_info(), which retrieves URL from accessibility tree and validates page load
Metric is_expected_url_pattern_match() correctly performs regex search on the URL to verify navigation to contact page
Pattern 'united.com/en/us/contact' appropriately matches the expected contact page URL structure
Evaluator provides complete coverage of the instruction requirement: verifying navigation to the customer service contact page
Data flow is semantically correct: getter extracts URL state -> metric compares against expected pattern -> returns 1.0 for match
Pattern matching is flexible enough to handle slight URL variations (e.g., /contact, /contact-us, /contact/phone) which is reasonable for a contact page navigation task
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: The pattern could be more specific if only exact '/contact' endpoint is desired (e.g., 'united\.com/en/us/contact$' with anchor), though current flexibility is likely acceptable
Minor: Could add explicit page load success verification beyond URL matching, though get_active_tab_info() already waits for page load states
